criteria.explicit_reading: Only source_record_ids_read and body_ids_read count; missing supplemental_sections_read_ids or bibliography_sections_read_ids remain false. criteria.class_A: Exact hash match plus explicit source and body reading and explicit supplemental and bibliography coverage in a parent-reading note; complete_current_reuse remains false pending fresh adjudication.
criteria.class_B: Exact hash match with accepted unavailable-body status or other reusable source provenance but no complete current reading; retain unavailable status.
criteria.class_C: No exact accepted ledger hash match with usable parent provenance; fresh source/projection review required.
criteria.visuals: Only actual visual_readings records are carried; no visual claim is inferred from markup counts.
